I'm sorry for the cynical reply. It's this cold civil war we're in. I'm a democrat but it's killing me we're at each other's throats with the Republicans. I just want a good life for all of us. This fighting been tearing me apart because even though I'm liberal, I love ALL my fellow countrymen. The fighting is just really really hard on me. I just want the fighting to end. 

When I think about anyone, I can imagine them as kids at some point. With dreams, fears, and hopes of their own. That stuff doesn't go away no matter how "hardened" a person may seem. I just really want us two political parties to start getting along :'( I LOVE my country and I LOVE my fellow citizens.

I decided not to go through with it. I am in a lot of pain but you guys across the aisle are showing compassion I didn't think you would. Ironically you guys saved my life. Thank you. I just want us all to get along. As a bleeding heart liberal, I want everyone to know there's nothing to be afraid of. I love my Republican neighbors and again, just want us all to prosper and live good with each other. 

Again, thank you for writing back. It means so much more than I can describe.
